node.title: Actual pair-owned collision jets give a nonzero polynomial incidence bound
node.statement: For M actual polynomial operator3 pairs off original-field eigen roots, collision fibres of maximum actual occupancy r consume disjoint sets of binom(r,2) unordered pairs. If the degree-ell product rank exceeds their total, a nonzero multiplicity interpolant bounds collision excess by D*ell and total core incidence by B+n+D*ell. The product rank is the exact Hilbert function of the plane image. No generic fibre or formal-hull source census is substituted.
